citations.claim: N shows red at first violating step 69 after only 3s of yellow
N still green at step 65 just before yellow
N still yellow at step 68, so yellow spanned only steps 66-68 (3s) vs required 5s

counterfactual.change: Set actuated true->false only; fixed-time control lets yellow run full 5s so no violation

explanation: With actuated=true and no events, NS green gaps out early while W has waited ~60s (recall). The controller starts NS yellow at step 66 but aborts it to all-red at step 69 after only 3s instead of the required yellow_seconds=5, truncating the yellow to serve the recalled direction.
vision_note: The north and south approaches show yellow in steps 66 through 68 while east and west stay red with a queue building on the west approach. At step 69 all four approaches show red, so the yellow disappears after only three seconds instead of holding for the required duration.
